1.text: Tha book of tha generation of Jesus Christ, tha son of David, tha son of Abraham.
Abraham fathered Isaac; N Isaac fathered Jacob; N Jacob fathered Judas N his brothers;
N Judas fathered Phares N Zara of Thamar; N Phares fathered Esrom; N Esrom fathered Aram;
N Aram fathered Aminadab; N Aminadab fathered Naasson; N Naasson fathered Salmon;
N Salmon fathered Booz of Rachab; N Booz fathered Obed of Ruth; N Obed fathered Jesse;
N Jesse fathered David tha king; N David tha king fathered Solomon of her dat had been tha wife of Urias;
N Solomon fathered Roboam; N Roboam fathered Abia; N Abia fathered Asa;
N Asa fathered Josaphat; N Josaphat fathered Joram; N Joram fathered Ozias;
N Ozias fathered Joatham; N Joatham fathered Achaz; N Achaz fathered Ezekias;
N Ezekias fathered Manasses; N Manasses fathered Amon; N Amon fathered Josias;
N Josias fathered Jechonias N his brothers, about tha time dey were carried away 2 Babylon:
N after dey were brought 2 Babylon, Jechonias fathered Salathiel; N Salathiel fathered Zorobabel;
N Zorobabel fathered Abiud; N Abiud fathered Eliakim; N Eliakim fathered Azor;
N Azor fathered Sadoc; N Sadoc fathered Achim; N Achim fathered Eliud;
N Eliud fathered Eleazar; N Eleazar fathered Matthan; N Matthan fathered Jacob;
N Jacob fathered Joseph tha husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

So all tha generations from Abraham 2 David r fourteen generations; N from David until tha carryin away in2 Babylon r fourteen generations; N from tha carryin away in2 Babylon 2 Christ r fourteen generations.
Now tha birth of Jesus Christ was on dis wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused 2 Joseph, before dey came together, she was found wit child of tha Holy Ghost.
Then Joseph her husband, bein a just man, N not willin 2 make her a publick example, was minded 2 put her away privily.

But while he thought on dese things, look, tha angel of tha Lord appeared 2 him in a dream, sayin, Joseph, u son of David, don’t fear 2 take 2 u Mary ur wife: 4 dat which is conceived in her is of tha Holy Ghost.
N she shall bring forth a son, N u will call his name JESUS: 4 he shall save his people from their sins.
Now all dis was done, dat it might be fulfilled which was spoken of tha Lord by tha prophet, sayin,
Look, a virgin shall be wit child, N shall bring forth a son, N dey shall call his name Emmanuel, which bein interpreted is, God wit us.
Then Joseph bein raised from sleep did as tha angel of tha Lord had bidden him, N took 2 him his wife:
N knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: N he called his name JESUS.

2.text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in tha days of Herod tha king, look, there came wise men from tha east 2 Jerusalem,
Sayin, Where is he dat is born King of tha Jews? 4 we have seen his star in tha east, N r come 2 worship him.
When Herod tha king had heard dese things, he was troubled, N all Jerusalem wit him.
N when he had gathered all tha chief priests N scribes of tha people together, he demanded of ’em where Christ should be born.
N dey said 2 him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: 4 like dis it is written by tha prophet,
N u Bethlehem, in tha land of Juda, art not tha least among tha princes of Juda: 4 out of u shall come a Governor, dat shall rule my people Israel.
Then Herod, when he had privily called tha wise men, enquired of ’em diligently what time tha star appeared.
N he sent ’em 2 Bethlehem, N said, Go N search diligently 4 tha young child; N when y’all have found him, bring me word again, dat I may come N worship him also.
When dey had heard tha king, dey departed; N, look, tha star, which dey saw in tha east, went before ’em, till it came N stood over where tha young child was.
When dey saw tha star, dey rejoiced wit exceeding great joy.

N when dey were come in2 tha house, dey saw tha young child wit Mary his mother, N fell down, N worshipped him: N when dey had opened their treasures, dey presented 2 him gifts; gold, N frankincense, N myrrh.
N bein warned of God in a dream dat dey should not return 2 Herod, dey departed in2 their own country another way.

N when dey were departed, look, tha angel of tha Lord appears 2 Joseph in a dream, sayin, Arise, N take tha young child N his mother, N flee in2 Egypt, N be u there until I bring u word: 4 Herod will seek tha young child 2 destroy him.
When he arose, he took tha young child N his mother by night, N departed in2 Egypt:
N was there until tha death of Herod: dat it might be fulfilled which was spoken of tha Lord by tha prophet, sayin, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

Then Herod, when he saw dat he was mocked of tha wise men, was exceeding angry, N sent forth, N killed all tha children dat were in Bethlehem, N in all tha coasts of it, from two years old N under, according 2 tha time which he had diligently enquired of tha wise men.
Then was fulfilled dat which was spoken by Jeremy tha prophet, sayin,
In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, N weepin, N great mournin, Rachel weepin 4 her children, N would not be comforted, because dey r not.
But when Herod was dead, look, an angel of tha Lord appears in a dream 2 Joseph in Egypt,
Sayin, Arise, N take tha young child N his mother, N go in2 tha land of Israel: 4 dey r dead which sought tha young child’s life.
N he arose, N took tha young child N his mother, N came in2 tha land of Israel.
But when he heard dat Archelaus did reign in Judaea in tha room of his father Herod, he was afraid 2 go there: even so, bein warned of God in a dream, he turned aside in2 tha parts of Galilee:
N he came N lived in a city called Nazareth: dat it might be fulfilled which was spoken by tha prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

3.text: In dose days came John tha Baptist, preachin in tha wilderness of Judaea,
N sayin, Repent y’all: 4 tha kingdom of heaven is at hand.
4 dis is he dat was spoken of by tha prophet Esaias, sayin, tha voice of one cryin in tha wilderness, Prepare y’all tha way of tha Lord, make his paths straight.
N tha same John had his clothing of camel’s hair, N a leathern girdle about his loins; N his food was locusts N wild honey.
Then went out 2 him Jerusalem, N all Judaea, N all tha region round about Jordan,
N were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
But when he saw many of tha Pharisees N Sadducees come 2 his baptism, he said 2 ’em, O generation of vipers, who has warned u 2 flee from tha wrath 2 come?
Bring forth therefore fruits meet 4 repentance:
N think not 2 say within y’all, We have Abraham 2 our father: 4 I say 2 u, dat God is able of dese stones 2 raise up children 2 Abraham.
N now also tha axe is laid 2 tha root of tha trees: therefore every tree which brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, N cast in2 tha fire.
I indeed baptize u wit water 2 repentance: but he dat comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy 2 bear: he shall baptize u wit tha Holy Ghost, N wit fire:
Whose fan is in his hand, N he will throughly purge his floor, N gather his wheat in2 tha garner; but he will burn up tha chaff wit unquenchable fire.
Then comes Jesus from Galilee 2 Jordan 2 John, 2 be baptized of him.
But John forbad him, sayin, I have need 2 be baptized of u, N come u 2 me?
N Jesus answerin said 2 him, Suffer it 2 be so now: 4 like dis it becomes us 2 fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
N Jesus, when he was baptized, went up right away out of tha water: N, look, tha heavenz were opened 2 him, N he saw tha Spirit of God descending like a dove, N lighting upon him:
N look a voice from heaven, sayin, dis is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

4.text: Then was Jesus led up of tha Spirit in2 tha wilderness 2 be tempted of tha devil.
N when he had fasted forty days N forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
N when tha tempter came 2 him, he said, If u be tha Son of God, command dat dese stones be made bread.
But he answered, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word dat proceeds out of tha mouth of God.
Then tha devil takes him up in2 tha holy city, N sets him on a pinnacle of tha temple,

N says 2 him, If u be tha Son of God, cast urself down: 4 it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning u: N in their hands dey shall bear u up, lest at any time u dash ur foot against a stone.
Jesus said 2 him, It is written again, u will not tempt tha Lord ur God.
Again, tha devil takes him up in2 an exceeding high mountain, N shows him all tha kingdoms of tha world, N tha glory of ’em;
N says 2 him, All dese things will I give u, if u will fall down N worship me.
Then says Jesus 2 him, Get u hence, Satan: 4 it is written, u will worship tha Lord ur God, N him only will u serve.
Then tha devil leaves him, N, look, angels came N ministered 2 him.
Now when Jesus had heard dat John was cast in2 prison, he departed in2 Galilee;
N leavin Nazareth, he came N lived in Capernaum, which is upon tha sea coast, in tha borders of Zabulon N Nephthalim:
Dat it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias tha prophet, sayin,
Tha land of Zabulon, N tha land of Nephthalim, by tha way of tha sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of tha Gentiles;
Tha people which sat in darkness saw great light; N 2 ’em which sat in tha region N shadow of death light is sprung up.
From dat time Jesus began 2 preach, N 2 say, Repent: 4 tha kingdom of heaven is at hand.
N Jesus, walkin by tha sea of Galilee, saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, N Andrew his brother, castin a net in2 tha sea: 4 dey were fishers.
N he says 2 ’em, Follow me, N I will make u fishers of men.
N dey right away left their nets, N followed him.
N goin on from thence, he saw other two brothers, James tha son of Zebedee, N John his brother, in a ship wit Zebedee their father, mending their nets; N he called ’em.
N dey right away left tha ship N their father, N followed him.
N Jesus went about all Galilee, teachin in their synagogues, N preachin tha gospel of tha kingdom, N healin all manner of sickness N all manner of disease among tha people.

N his fame went throughout all Syria: N dey brought 2 him all sick people dat were taken wit divers diseases N torments, N dose which were possessed wit devils, N dose which were lunatick, N dose dat had tha palsy; N he healed ’em.
N there followed him great crowds of people from Galilee, N from Decapolis, N from Jerusalem, N from Judaea, N from beyond Jordan.

5.text: N seein tha crowds, he went up in2 a mountain: N when he was set, his disciples came 2 him:
N he opened his mouth, N taught ’em, sayin,
Blessed r tha poor in spirit: 4 theirs is tha kingdom of heaven.
Blessed r dey dat mourn: 4 dey shall be comforted.
Blessed r tha meek: 4 dey shall inherit tha earth.
Blessed r dey which do hunger N thirst after righteousness: 4 dey shall be filled.
Blessed r tha merciful: 4 dey shall obtain mercy.
Blessed r tha pure in heart: 4 dey shall see God.
Blessed r tha peacemakers: 4 dey shall be called tha children of God.
Blessed r dey which r persecuted 4 righteousness’ sake: 4 theirs is tha kingdom of heaven.
Blessed r y’all, when men shall revile u, N persecute u, N shall say all manner of evil against u falsely, 4 my sake.
Rejoice, N be exceeding glad: 4 great is ur reward in heaven: 4 so persecuted dey tha prophets which were before u.
y’all r tha salt of tha earth: but if tha salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good 4 nothing, but 2 be cast out, N 2 be trodden under foot of men.
y’all r tha light of tha world. A city dat is set on an hill cannot be hid.
Neither do men light a candle, N put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; N it gives light 2 all dat r in tha house.
Let ur light so shine before men, dat dey may see ur good works, N glorify ur Father which is in heaven.
Think not dat I am come 2 destroy tha law, or tha prophets: I am not come 2 destroy, but 2 fulfil.
4 for real I say 2 u, Till heaven N earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from tha law, till all be fulfilled.

Whoever therefore shall break one of dese least commandments, N shall teach men so, he shall be called tha least in tha kingdom of heaven: but whoever shall do N teach ’em, tha same shall be called great in tha kingdom of heaven.
4 I say 2 u, dat except ur righteousness shall exceed tha righteousness of tha scribes N Pharisees, y’all shall in no case enter in2 tha kingdom of heaven.
y’all have heard dat it was said by ’em of old time, u will not kill; N whoever shall kill shall be in danger of tha judgment:

But I say 2 u, dat whoever is angry wit his brother without a cause shall be in danger of tha judgment: N whoever shall say 2 his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of tha council: but whoever shall say, u fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
Therefore if u bring ur gift 2 tha altar, N there rememberest dat ur brother has ought against u;
Leave there ur gift before tha altar, N go ur way; first be reconciled 2 ur brother, N then come N offer ur gift.
Agree wit thine adversary quickly, whiles u r in tha way wit him; lest at any time tha adversary deliver u 2 tha judge, N tha judge deliver u 2 tha officer, N u be cast in2 prison.
For real I say 2 u, u will by no means come out thence, till u have paid tha uttermost farthing.
y’all have heard dat it was said by ’em of old time, u will not commit adultery:
But I say 2 u, dat whoever looks on a woman 2 lust after her has committed adultery wit her already in his heart.
N if ur right eye offend u, pluck it out, N cast it from u: 4 it is profitable 4 u dat one of ur members should perish, N not dat ur whole body should be cast in2 hell.
N if ur right hand offend u, cut it off, N cast it from u: 4 it is profitable 4 u dat one of ur members should perish, N not dat ur whole body should be cast in2 hell.
It has been said, whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
But I say 2 u, dat whoever shall put away his wife, saving 4 tha cause of fornication, causes her 2 commit adultery: N whoever shall marry her dat is divorced commits adultery.
Again, y’all have heard dat it has been said by ’em of old time, u will not forswear urself, but will perform 2 tha Lord thine oaths:
But I say 2 u, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; 4 it is God’s throne:
Nor by tha earth; 4 it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; 4 it is tha city of tha great King.
Neither will u swear by ur head, because u can not make one hair white or black.
But let ur communication be, yeah, yeah; no, no: 4 whatever is more than dese comes of evil.
y’all have heard dat it has been said, an eye 4 an eye, N a tooth 4 a tooth:
But I say 2 u, dat y’all resist not evil: but whoever shall strike u on ur right cheek, turn 2 him tha other also.
N if any man will sue u at tha law, N take away ur coat, let him have ur cloke also.
N whoever shall compel u 2 go a mile, go wit him twain.
Give 2 him dat asks u, N from him dat would borrow of u turn not u away.
y’all have heard dat it has been said, u will love ur neighbour, N hate thine opp.
But I say 2 u, Love ur opps, bless ’em dat curse u, do good 2 ’em dat hate u, N pray 4 ’em which despitefully use u, N persecute u;
Dat y’all may be tha children of ur Father which is in heaven: 4 he makes his sun 2 rise on tha evil N on tha good, N sends rain on tha just N on tha unjust.
4 if y’all love ’em which love u, what reward have y’all? do not even tha publicans tha same?
N if y’all greet ur brothers only, what do y’all more than others? do not even tha publicans so?
Be y’all therefore perfect, even as ur Father which is in heaven is perfect.

6.text: Pay attention dat y’all do not ur alms before men, 2 be seen of ’em: otherwise y’all have no reward of ur Father which is in heaven.
Therefore when u do thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before u, as tha hypocrites do in tha synagogues N in tha streets, dat dey may have glory of men. for real I say 2 u, dey have their reward.
But when u do alms, don’t let ur left hand know what ur right hand does:
Dat thine alms may be in secret: N ur Father which sees in secret himself shall reward u openly.
N when u pray, u will not be as tha hypocrites r: 4 dey love 2 pray standin in tha synagogues N in tha corners of tha streets, dat dey may be seen of men. for real I say 2 u, dey have their reward.
But u, when u pray, enter in2 ur closet, N when u have shut ur door, pray 2 ur Father which is in secret; N ur Father which sees in secret shall reward u openly.
But when y’all pray, use not vain repetitions, as tha heathen do: 4 dey think dat dey shall be heard 4 their much speakin.
Don’t be y’all therefore like 2 ’em: 4 ur Father knows what things y’all have need of, before y’all ask him.
After dis manner therefore pray y’all: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be ur name.
Ur kingdom come. ur will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
Give us dis day our daily bread.
N forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
N lead us not in2 temptation, but deliver us from evil: 4 thine is tha kingdom, N tha power, N tha glory, 4 ever. Amen.
4 if y’all forgive men their trespasses, ur heavenly Father will also forgive u:
But if y’all forgive not men their trespasses, neither will ur Father forgive ur trespasses.
Moreover when y’all fast, don’t be, as tha hypocrites, of a sad countenance: 4 dey disfigure their faces, dat dey may appear 2 men 2 fast. for real I say 2 u, dey have their reward.
But u, when u fastest, anoint thine head, N wash ur face;
Dat u appear not 2 men 2 fast, but 2 ur Father which is in secret: N ur Father, which sees in secret, shall reward u openly.
Lay not up 4 y’all treasures upon earth, where moth N rust does corrupt, N where thieves break through N steal:
But lay up 4 y’all treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust does corrupt, N where thieves do not break through nor steal:
4 where ur treasure is, there will ur heart be also.
Tha light of tha body is tha eye: if therefore thine eye be single, ur whole body shall be full of light.
But if thine eye be evil, ur whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore tha light dat is in u be darkness, how great is dat darkness!
No man can serve two masters: 4 either he will hate tha one, N love tha other; or else he will hold 2 tha one, N despise tha other. y’all cannot serve God N mammon.
Therefore I say 2 u, Take no thought 4 ur life, what y’all shall eat, or what y’all shall drink; nor yet 4 ur body, what y’all shall put on. Is not tha life more than food, N tha body than clothing?
Look tha fowls of tha air: 4 dey sow not, neither do dey reap, nor gather in2 barns; yet ur heavenly Father feeds ’em. r y’all not much better than dey?
Which of u by takin thought can add one cubit 2 his stature?
N why take y’all thought 4 clothing? Consider tha lilies of tha field, how dey grow; dey toil not, neither do dey spin:
N yet I say 2 u, dat even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of dese.
So, if God so clothe tha grass of tha field, which 2 day is, N 2 morrow is cast in2 tha oven, shall he not much more clothe u, O y’all of little faith?
Therefore take no thought, sayin, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
(4 after all dese things do tha Gentiles seek:) 4 ur heavenly Father knows dat y’all have need of all dese things.
But seek y’all first tha kingdom of God, N his righteousness; N all dese things shall be added 2 u.
Take therefore no thought 4 tha morrow: 4 tha morrow shall take thought 4 tha things of itself. Sufficient 2 tha day is tha evil of it.

7.text: Judge not, dat y’all don’t be judged.
4 wit what judgment y’all judge, y’all shall be judged: N wit what measure y’all mete, it shall be measured 2 u again.
N why beholdest u tha mote dat is in ur brother’s eye, but consider not tha beam dat is in ur own eye?
Or how will u say 2 ur brother, Let me pull out tha mote out of thine eye; N, look, a beam is in ur own eye?
u hypocrite, first cast out tha beam out of ur own eye; N then will u see clearly 2 cast out tha mote out of ur brother’s eye.
Give not dat which is holy 2 tha dogs, neither cast y’all ur pearls before swine, lest dey trample ’em under their feet, N turn again N rend u.
Ask, N it will be given u; seek, N y’all shall find; knock, N it will be opened 2 u:
4 every one dat asks receives; N he dat seeks finds; N 2 him dat knocketh it shall be opened.
Or what man is there of u, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
If y’all then, bein evil, know how 2 give good gifts 2 ur children, how much more shall ur Father which is in heaven give good things 2 ’em dat ask him?
Therefore all things whatever y’all would dat men should do 2 u, do y’all even so 2 ’em: 4 dis is tha law N tha prophets.
Enter y’all in at tha strait gate: 4 wide is tha gate, N broad is tha way, dat leads 2 destruction, N many there be which go in thereat:
Because strait is tha gate, N narrow is tha way, which leads 2 life, N few there be dat find it.
Beware of false prophets, which come 2 u in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly dey r ravening wolves.
y’all shall know ’em by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
Even so every good tree brings forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree brings forth evil fruit.
A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
Every tree dat brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, N cast in2 tha fire.
So by their fruits y’all shall know ’em.
Not every one dat says 2 me, Lord, Lord, shall enter in2 tha kingdom of heaven; but he dat does tha will of my Father which is in heaven.
Many will say 2 me in dat day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in ur name? N in ur name have cast out devils? N in ur name done many wonderful works?
N then will I profess 2 ’em, I never knew u: depart from me, y’all dat work iniquity.
Therefore whoever hears dese sayings of mine, N does ’em, I will liken him 2 a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
N tha rain descended, N tha floods came, N tha winds blew, N beat upon dat house; N it fell not: 4 it was founded upon a rock.
N every one dat hears dese sayings of mine, N does ’em not, shall be likened 2 a foolish man, which built his house upon tha sand:
N tha rain descended, N tha floods came, N tha winds blew, N beat upon dat house; N it fell: N great was tha fall of it.
N it happened, when Jesus had ended dese sayings, tha people were astonished at his doctrine:
4 he taught ’em as one havin authority, N not as tha scribes.

8.text: When he was come down from tha mountain, great crowds followed him.
N, look, there came a leper N worshipped him, sayin, Lord, if u will, u can make me clean.
N Jesus put forth his hand, N touched him, sayin, I will; be u clean. N right away his leprosy was cleansed.
N Jesus says 2 him, See u tell no man; but go ur way, show urself 2 tha priest, N offer tha gift dat Moses commanded, 4 a testimony 2 ’em.
N when Jesus was entered in2 Capernaum, there came 2 him a centurion, beseeching him,
N sayin, Lord, my servant lies at home sick of tha palsy, grievously tormented.
N Jesus says 2 him, I will come N heal him.
Tha centurion answered, Lord, I am not worthy dat u should come under my roof: but speak tha word only, N my servant shall be healed.
4 I am a man under authority, havin soldiers under me: N I say 2 dis man, Go, N he goes; N 2 another, Come, N he comes; N 2 my servant, Do dis, N he does it.
When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, N said 2 ’em dat followed, for real I say 2 u, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
N I say 2 u, dat many shall come from tha east N west, N shall sit down wit Abraham, N Isaac, N Jacob, in tha kingdom of heaven.
But tha children of tha kingdom shall be cast out in2 outer darkness: there shall be weepin N gnashing of teeth.
N Jesus said 2 tha centurion, Go ur way; N as u have believed, so be it done 2 u. N his servant was healed in tha selfsame hour.
N when Jesus was come in2 Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, N sick of a fever.
N he touched her hand, N tha fever left her: N she arose, N ministered 2 ’em.
When tha even was come, dey brought 2 him many dat were possessed wit devils: N he cast out tha spirits wit his word, N healed all dat were sick:
Dat it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias tha prophet, sayin, Himself took our infirmities, N bare our sicknesses.
Now when Jesus saw great crowds about him, he gave commandment 2 depart 2 tha other side.
N a certain scribe came, N said 2 him, Master, I will follow u wherever u go.
N Jesus says 2 him, tha foxes have holes, N tha birds of tha air have nests; but tha Son of man has not where 2 lay his head.
N another of his disciples said 2 him, Lord, suffer me first 2 go N bury my father.
But Jesus said 2 him, Follow me; N let tha dead bury their dead.
N when he was entered in2 a ship, his disciples followed him.
N, look, there arose a great tempest in tha sea, insomuch dat tha ship was covered wit tha waves: but he was asleep.
N his disciples came 2 him, N awoke him, sayin, Lord, save us: we perish.
N he says 2 ’em, Why r y’all fearful, O y’all of little faith? Then he arose, N rebuked tha winds N tha sea; N there was a great calm.
But tha men marvelled, sayin, What manner of man is dis, dat even tha winds N tha sea obey him!
N when he was come 2 tha other side in2 tha country of tha Gergesenes, there met him two possessed wit devils, comin out of tha tombs, exceeding fierce, so dat no man might pass by dat way.
N, look, dey cried out, sayin, What have we 2 do wit u, Jesus, u Son of God? r u come here 2 torment us before tha time?
N there was a good way off from ’em an herd of many swine feedin.
So tha devils besought him, sayin, If u cast us out, suffer us 2 go away in2 tha herd of swine.
N he said 2 ’em, Go. N when dey were come out, dey went in2 tha herd of swine: N, look, tha whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place in2 tha sea, N perished in tha waterz.
N dey dat kept ’em fled, N went their ways in2 tha city, N told every thing, N what was befallen 2 tha possessed of tha devils.
N, look, tha whole city came out 2 meet Jesus: N when dey saw him, dey besought him dat he would depart out of their coasts.

9.text: N he entered in2 a ship, N passed over, N came in2 his own city.
N, look, dey brought 2 him a man sick of tha palsy, lyin on a bed: N Jesus seein their faith said 2 tha sick of tha palsy; Son, be of good cheer; ur sins be forgiven u.
N, look, certain of tha scribes said within themselves, dis man blasphemeth.
N Jesus knowin their thoughts said, so think y’all evil in ur hearts?
4 whether is easier, 2 say, ur sins be forgiven u; or 2 say, Arise, N walk?
But dat y’all may know dat tha Son of man has power on earth 2 forgive sins, (then says he 2 tha sick of tha palsy,) Arise, take up ur bed, N go 2 thine house.
N he arose, N departed 2 his house.
But when tha crowds saw it, dey marvelled, N glorified God, which had given such power 2 men.
N as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sittin at tha receipt of custom: N he says 2 him, Follow me. N he arose, N followed him.

N honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. like dis have y’all made tha commandment of God of none effect by ur tradition.
y’all hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of u, sayin,
Dis people draws nigh 2 me wit their mouth, N honors me wit their lips; but their heart is far from me.
But in vain dey do worship me, teachin 4 doctrines tha commandments of men.
N he called tha crowd, N said 2 ’em, Hear, N understand:
Not dat which goes in2 tha mouth defiles a man; but dat which comes out of tha mouth, dis defiles a man.
Then came his disciples, N said 2 him, know u dat tha Pharisees were offended, after dey heard dis sayin?
But he answered, Every plant, which my heavenly Father has not planted, shall be rooted up.
Let ’em alone: dey be blind leaders of tha blind. N if tha blind lead tha blind, both shall fall in2 tha ditch.
Then answered Peter N said 2 him, Declare 2 us dis parable.
N Jesus said, r y’all also yet without understanding?
Do not y’all yet understand, dat whatever enters in at tha mouth goes in2 tha belly, N is cast out in2 tha draught?
But dose things which proceed out of tha mouth come forth from tha heart; N dey defile tha man.
4 out of tha heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
Dese r tha things which defile a man: but 2 eat wit unwashen hands defiles not a man.
Then Jesus went thence, N departed in2 tha coasts of Tyre N Sidon.
N, look, a woman of Canaan came out of tha same coasts, N cried 2 him, sayin, Have mercy on me, O Lord, u Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed wit a devil.
But he answered her not a word. N his disciples came N besought him, sayin, Send her away; 4 she cries after us.
But he answered, I am not sent but 2 tha lost sheep of tha house of Israel.
Then came she N worshipped him, sayin, Lord, help me.
But he answered, It is not meet 2 take tha children’s bread, N 2 cast it 2 dogs.
N she said, Truth, Lord: yet tha dogs eat of tha crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
Then Jesus answered 2 her, O woman, great is ur faith: be it 2 u even as u will. N her daughter was made whole from dat very hour.
N Jesus departed from thence, N came nigh 2 tha sea of Galilee; N went up in2 a mountain, N sat down there.
N great crowds came 2 him, havin wit ’em dose dat were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, N many others, N cast ’em down at Jesus’ feet; N he healed ’em:
Insomuch dat tha crowd wondered, when dey saw tha dumb 2 speak, tha maimed 2 be whole, tha lame 2 walk, N tha blind 2 see: N dey glorified tha God of Israel.

Then Jesus called his disciples 2 him, N said, I have compassion on tha crowd, because dey continue wit me now three days, N have nothing 2 eat: N I will not send ’em away fasting, lest dey faint in tha way.

N Jesus says 2 ’em, How many loaves have y’all? N dey said, Seven, N a few little fishes.
N he commanded tha crowd 2 sit down on tha ground.
N he took tha seven loaves N tha fishes, N gave thanks, N broke ’em, N gave 2 his disciples, N tha disciples 2 tha crowd.
N dey did all eat, N were filled: N dey took up of tha broken food dat was left seven baskets full.
N dey dat did eat were four thousand men, beside women N children.
N he sent away tha crowd, N took ship, N came in2 tha coasts of Magdala.

16.text: Tha Pharisees also wit tha Sadducees came, N tempting desired him dat he would show ’em a sign from heaven.
He answered 2 ’em, When it is evening, y’all say, It will be fair weather: 4 tha sky is red.
N in tha morning, It will be foul weather 2 day: 4 tha sky is red N lowring. O y’all hypocrites, y’all can discern tha face of tha sky; but can y’all not discern tha signs of tha times?

N when his disciples were come 2 tha other side, dey had forgotten 2 take bread.
Then Jesus said 2 ’em, pay attention N beware of tha leaven of tha Pharisees N of tha Sadducees.
N dey reasoned among themselves, sayin, It is because we have taken no bread.
Which when Jesus perceived, he said 2 ’em, O y’all of little faith, why reason y’all among y’all, because y’all have brought no bread?
Do y’all not yet understand, neither remember tha five loaves of tha five thousand, N how many baskets y’all took up?
Neither tha seven loaves of tha four thousand, N how many baskets y’all took up?
How is it dat y’all do not understand dat I spoke it not 2 u concerning bread, dat y’all should beware of tha leaven of tha Pharisees N of tha Sadducees?
Then understood dey how dat he told ’em not beware of tha leaven of bread, but of tha doctrine of tha Pharisees N of tha Sadducees.
When Jesus came in2 tha coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, sayin, Whom do men say dat I tha Son of man am?
N dey said, Some say dat u r John tha Baptist: some, Elias; N others, Jeremias, or one of tha prophets.
He says 2 ’em, But whom say y’all dat I am?
N Simon Peter answered, u r tha Christ, tha Son of tha livin God.
N Jesus answered 2 him, Blessed r u, Simon Bar-jona: 4 flesh N blood has not revealed it 2 u, but my Father which is in heaven.
N I say also 2 u, dat u r Peter, N upon dis rock I will build my church; N tha gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
N I will give 2 u tha keys of tha kingdom of heaven: N whatever u will bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: N whatever u will loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
Then charged he his disciples dat dey should tell no man dat he was Jesus tha Christ.
From dat time forth began Jesus 2 show 2 his disciples, how dat he must go 2 Jerusalem, N suffer many things of tha elders N chief priests N scribes, N be killed, N be raised again tha third day.
Then Peter took him, N began 2 rebuke him, sayin, Be it far from u, Lord: dis shall not be 2 u.
But he turned, N said 2 Peter, Get u behind me, Satan: u r an offence 2 me: 4 u savourest not tha things dat be of God, but dose dat be of men.
Then said Jesus 2 his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, N take up his cross, N follow me.
4 whoever will save his life shall lose it: N whoever will lose his life 4 my sake shall find it.
4 what is a man profited, if he shall gain tha whole world, N lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange 4 his soul?
4 tha Son of man shall come in tha glory of his Father wit his angels; N then he shall reward every man according 2 his works.
For real I say 2 u, There be some standin here, which shall not taste of death, till dey see tha Son of man comin in his kingdom.

17.text: N after six days Jesus takes Peter, James, N John his brother, N brings ’em up in2 an high mountain apart,
N was transfigured before ’em: N his face did shine as tha sun, N his clothing was white as tha light.
N, look, there appeared 2 ’em Moses N Elias talking wit him.

N when tha disciples heard it, dey fell on their face, N were sore afraid.
N Jesus came N touched ’em, N said, Arise, N don’t be afraid.
N when dey had lifted up their eyes, dey saw no man, save Jesus only.
N as dey came down from tha mountain, Jesus charged ’em, sayin, Tell tha vision 2 no man, until tha Son of man be risen again from tha dead.
N his disciples asked him, sayin, Why then say tha scribes dat Elias must first come?
N Jesus answered 2 ’em, Elias truly shall first come, N restore all things.
But I say 2 u, dat Elias is come already, N dey knew him not, but have done 2 him whatever dey listed. Likewise shall also tha Son of man suffer of ’em.
Then tha disciples understood dat he spoke 2 ’em of John tha Baptist.
N when dey were come 2 tha crowd, there came 2 him a certain man, kneeling down 2 him, N sayin,
Lord, have mercy on my son: 4 he is lunatick, N sore vexed: 4 ofttimes he falls in2 tha fire, N oft in2 tha water.
N I brought him 2 ur disciples, N dey could not cure him.
Then Jesus answered, O faithless N perverse generation, how long shall I be wit u? how long shall I suffer u? bring him here 2 me.
N Jesus rebuked tha devil; N he departed out of him: N tha child was cured from dat very hour.
Then came tha disciples 2 Jesus apart, N said, Why could not we cast him out?

N Jesus said 2 ’em, Because of ur unbelief: 4 for real I say 2 u, If y’all have faith as a grain of mustard seed, y’all shall say 2 dis mountain, Remove hence 2 yonder place; N it shall remove; N nothing shall be impossible 2 u.
But dis kind goes not out but by prayer N fasting.
N while dey stayed in Galilee, Jesus said 2 ’em, tha Son of man shall be betrayed in2 tha hands of men:
N dey shall kill him, N tha third day he shall be raised again. N dey were exceeding sorry.
N when dey were come 2 Capernaum, dey dat received tribute money came 2 Peter, N said, does not ur master pay tribute?
He says, Yes. N when he was come in2 tha house, Jesus prevented him, sayin, What think u, Simon? of whom do tha kings of tha earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
Peter says 2 him, Of strangers. Jesus says 2 him, Then r tha children free.

Even so, lest we should offend ’em, go u 2 tha sea, N cast an hook, N take up tha fish dat first comes up; N when u have opened his mouth, u will find a piece of money: dat take, N give 2 ’em 4 me N u.

18.text: At tha same time came tha disciples 2 Jesus, sayin, Who is tha greatest in tha kingdom of heaven?
N Jesus called a little child 2 him, N set him in tha midst of ’em,
N said, for real I say 2 u, Except y’all be converted, N become as little children, y’all shall not enter in2 tha kingdom of heaven.
Whoever therefore shall humble himself as dis little child, tha same is greatest in tha kingdom of heaven.
N whoever shall receive one such little child in my name receives me.
But whoever shall offend one of dese little ones which believe in me, it were better 4 him dat a millstone were hanged about his neck, N dat he were drowned in tha depth of tha sea.
Woe 2 tha world because of offences! 4 it must needs be dat offences come; but woe 2 dat man by whom tha offence comes!
So if ur hand or ur foot offend u, cut ’em off, N cast ’em from u: it is better 4 u 2 enter in2 life halt or maimed, rather than havin two hands or two feet 2 be cast in2 everlasting fire.
N if thine eye offend u, pluck it out, N cast it from u: it is better 4 u 2 enter in2 life wit one eye, rather than havin two eyes 2 be cast in2 hell fire.
Pay attention dat y’all despise not one of dese little ones; 4 I say 2 u, dat in heaven their angels do always look tha face of my Father which is in heaven.
4 tha Son of man is come 2 save dat which was lost.
How think y’all? if a man have an hundred sheep, N one of ’em be gone astray, does he not leave tha ninety N nine, N goes in2 tha mountains, N seeks dat which is gone astray?
N if so be dat he find it, for real I say 2 u, he rejoices more of dat sheep, than of tha ninety N nine which went not astray.
Even so it is not tha will of ur Father which is in heaven, dat one of dese little ones should perish.
Moreover if ur brother shall trespass against u, go N tell him his fault between u N him alone: if he shall hear u, u have gained ur brother.
But if he will not hear u, then take wit u one or two more, dat in tha mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
N if he shall neglect 2 hear ’em, tell it 2 tha church: but if he neglect 2 hear tha church, let him be 2 u as an heathen man N a publican.
For real I say 2 u, whatever y’all shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: N whatever y’all shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
Again I say 2 u, dat if two of u shall agree on earth as touching any thing dat dey shall ask, it shall be done 4 ’em of my Father which is in heaven.
4 where two or three r gathered together in my name, there am I in tha midst of ’em.
Then came Peter 2 him, N said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, N I forgive him? till seven times?
Jesus says 2 him, I say not 2 u, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
Therefore is tha kingdom of heaven likened 2 a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
N when he had begun 2 reckon, one was brought 2 him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
But forasmuch as he had not 2 pay, his lord commanded him 2 be sold, N his wife, N children, N all dat he had, N payment 2 be made.
Tha servant therefore fell down, N worshipped him, sayin, Lord, have patience wit me, N I will pay u all.
Then tha lord of dat servant was moved wit compassion, N loosed him, N forgave him tha debt.
But tha same servant went out, N found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: N he laid hands on him, N took him by tha throat, sayin, Pay me dat u owest.
N his fellowservant fell down at his feet, N besought him, sayin, Have patience wit me, N I will pay u all.
N he would not: but went N cast him in2 prison, till he should pay tha debt.
So when his fellowservants saw what was done, dey were very sorry, N came N told 2 their lord all dat was done.
Then his lord, after dat he had called him, said 2 him, O u wicked servant, I forgave u all dat debt, because u desiredst me:
Should not u also have had compassion on ur fellowservant, even as I had pity on u?
N his lord was angry, N delivered him 2 tha tormentors, till he should pay all dat was due 2 him.
So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also 2 u, if y’all from ur hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

19.text: N it happened, dat when Jesus had finished dese sayings, he departed from Galilee, N came in2 tha coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
N great crowds followed him; N he healed ’em there.
Tha Pharisees also came 2 him, tempting him, N sayin 2 him, Is it lawful 4 a man 2 put away his wife 4 every cause?
N he answered 2 ’em, Have y’all not read, dat he which made ’em at tha beginning made ’em male N female,
N said, 4 dis cause shall a man leave father N mother, N shall cleave 2 his wife: N dey twain shall be one flesh?

Dey say 2 him, Why did Moses then command 2 give a writing of divorcement, N 2 put her away?

N I say 2 u, whoever shall put away his wife, except it be 4 fornication, N shall marry another, commits adultery: N whoever marrieth her which is put away does commit adultery.
His disciples say 2 him, If tha case of tha man be so wit his wife, it is not good 2 marry.
But he said 2 ’em, All men cannot receive dis sayin, save dey 2 whom it is given.

4 there r some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: N there r some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: N there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs 4 tha kingdom of heaven’s sake. He dat is able 2 receive it, let him receive it.
Then were there brought 2 him little children, dat he should put his hands on ’em, N pray: N tha disciples rebuked ’em.
But Jesus said, Suffer little children, N forbid ’em not, 2 come 2 me: 4 of such is tha kingdom of heaven.
N he laid his hands on ’em, N departed thence.
N, look, one came N said 2 him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, dat I may have eternal life?
N he said 2 him, Why call u me good? there is none good but one, dat is, God: but if u will enter in2 life, keep tha commandments.
He says 2 him, Which? Jesus said, u will do no murder, u will not commit adultery, u will not steal, u will not bear false witness,
Honour ur father N ur mother: N, u will love ur neighbour as urself.
Tha young man says 2 him, All dese things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
Jesus said 2 him, If u will be perfect, go N sell dat u have, N give 2 tha poor, N u will have treasure in heaven: N come N follow me.
But when tha young man heard dat sayin, he went away sorrowful: 4 he had great possessions.
Then said Jesus 2 his disciples, for real I say 2 u, dat a rich man shall hardly enter in2 tha kingdom of heaven.
N again I say 2 u, It is easier 4 a camel 2 go through tha eye of a needle, than 4 a rich man 2 enter in2 tha kingdom of God.
When his disciples heard it, dey were exceedingly amazed, sayin, Who then can be saved?
But Jesus beheld ’em, N said 2 ’em, wit men dis is impossible; but wit God all things r possible.

N Jesus said 2 ’em, for real I say 2 u, dat y’all which have followed me, in tha regeneration when tha Son of man shall sit in tha throne of his glory, y’all also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judgin tha twelve tribes of Israel.
N every one dat has forsaken houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, 4 my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, N shall inherit everlasting life.

20.text: 4 tha kingdom of heaven is like 2 a man dat is an householder, which went out early in tha morning 2 hire labourers in2 his vineyard.

N when dey came dat were hired about tha eleventh hour, dey received every man a penny.
But when tha first came, dey supposed dat dey should have received more; N dey likewise received every man a penny.
N when dey had received it, dey grumbled against tha goodman of tha house,

But he answered one of ’em, N said, Friend, I do u no wrong: did not u agree wit me 4 a penny?

N Jesus goin up 2 Jerusalem took tha twelve disciples apart in tha way, N said 2 ’em,

But Jesus answered, y’all know not what y’all ask. r y’all able 2 drink of tha cup dat I shall drink of, N 2 be baptized wit tha baptism dat I am baptized wit? dey say 2 him, We r able.

N he says 2 ’em, y’all shall drink indeed of my cup, N be baptized wit tha baptism dat I am baptized wit: but 2 sit on my right hand, N on my left, is not mine 2 give, but it shall be given 2 ’em 4 whom it is prepared of my Father.
N when tha ten heard it, dey were moved wit indignation against tha two brothers.
But Jesus called ’em 2 him, N said, y’all know dat tha princes of tha Gentiles exercise dominion over ’em, N dey dat r great exercise authority upon ’em.
But it shall not be so among u: but whoever will be great among u, let him be ur minister;
N whoever will be chief among u, let him be ur servant:

N as dey departed from Jericho, a great crowd followed him.
N, look, two blind men sittin by tha way side, when dey heard dat Jesus passed by, cried out, sayin, Have mercy on us, O Lord, u Son of David.

N Jesus stood still, N called ’em, N said, What will y’all dat I shall do 2 u?

So Jesus had compassion on ’em, N touched their eyes: N right away their eyes received sight, N dey followed him.

21.text: N when dey drew nigh 2 Jerusalem, N were come 2 Bethphage, 2 tha mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
Sayin 2 ’em, Go in2 tha village over against u, N right away y’all shall find an ass tied, N a colt wit her: loose ’em, N bring ’em 2 me.
N if any man say ought 2 u, y’all shall say, tha Lord has need of ’em; N right away he will send ’em.
All dis was done, dat it might be fulfilled which was spoken by tha prophet, sayin,
Tell y’all tha daughter of Sion, look, ur King comes 2 u, meek, N sittin upon an ass, N a colt tha foal of an ass.
N tha disciples went, N did as Jesus commanded ’em,
N brought tha ass, N tha colt, N put on ’em their clothes, N dey set him thereon.
N a very great crowd spread their garments in tha way; others cut down branches from tha trees, N strawed ’em in tha way.
N tha crowds dat went before, N dat followed, cried, sayin, Hosanna 2 tha Son of David: Blessed is he dat comes in tha name of tha Lord; Hosanna in tha highest.
N when he was come in2 Jerusalem, all tha city was moved, sayin, Who is dis?
N tha crowd said, dis is Jesus tha prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
N Jesus went in2 tha temple of God, N cast out all ’em dat sold N bought in tha temple, N overthrew tha tables of tha moneychangers, N tha seats of ’em dat sold doves,
N said 2 ’em, It is written, My house shall be called tha house of prayer; but y’all have made it a den of thieves.
N tha blind N tha lame came 2 him in tha temple; N he healed ’em.
N when tha chief priests N scribes saw tha wonderful things dat he did, N tha children cryin in tha temple, N sayin, Hosanna 2 tha Son of David; dey were sore displeased,
N said 2 him, hear u what dese say? N Jesus says 2 ’em, yeah; have y’all never read, Out of tha mouth of babes N sucklings u have perfected praise?
N he left ’em, N went out of tha city in2 Bethany; N he lodged there.
Now in tha morning as he returned in2 tha city, he hungered.
N when he saw a fig tree in tha way, he came 2 it, N found nothing thereon, but leaves only, N said 2 it, Let no fruit grow on u henceforward 4 ever. N presently tha fig tree withered away.

Jesus answered 2 ’em, for real I say 2 u, If y’all have faith, N doubt not, y’all shall not only do dis which is done 2 tha fig tree, but also if y’all shall say 2 dis mountain, Be u removed, N be u cast in2 tha sea; it shall be done.
N all things, whatever y’all shall ask in prayer, believin, y’all shall receive.
N when he was come in2 tha temple, tha chief priests N tha elders of tha people came 2 him as he was teachin, N said, By what authority do u dese things? N who gave u dis authority?
N Jesus answered 2 ’em, I also will ask u one thing, which if y’all tell me, I in like wise will tell u by what authority I do dese things.
Tha baptism of John, from where was it? from heaven, or of men? N dey reasoned wit themselves, sayin, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say 2 us, Why did y’all not then believe him?
But if we shall say, Of men; we fear tha people; 4 all hold John as a prophet.
N dey answered Jesus, N said, We cannot tell. N he said 2 ’em, Neither tell I u by what authority I do dese things.
But what think y’all? A certain man had two sons; N he came 2 tha first, N said, Son, go work 2 day in my vineyard.
He answered, I will not: but afterward he repented, N went.
N he came 2 tha second, N said likewise. N he answered, I go, sir: N went not.
Whether of ’em twain did tha will of his father? dey say 2 him, tha first. Jesus says 2 ’em, for real I say 2 u, dat tha publicans N tha harlots go in2 tha kingdom of God before u.

4 John came 2 u in tha way of righteousness, N y’all believed him not: but tha publicans N tha harlots believed him: N y’all, when y’all had seen it, repented not afterward, dat y’all might believe him.

Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, N hedged it round about, N digged a winepress in it, N built a tower, N let it out 2 husbandmen, N went in2 a far country:
N when tha time of tha fruit drew near, he sent his servants 2 tha husbandmen, dat dey might receive tha fruits of it.
N tha husbandmen took his servants, N beat one, N killed another, N stoned another.
Again, he sent other servants more than tha first: N dey did 2 ’em likewise.
But last of all he sent 2 ’em his son, sayin, dey will reverence my son.
But when tha husbandmen saw tha son, dey said among themselves, dis is tha heir; come, let us kill him, N let us seize on his inheritance.
N dey caught him, N cast him out of tha vineyard, N killed him.
When tha lord therefore of tha vineyard comes, what will he do 2 dose husbandmen?
Dey say 2 him, He will miserably destroy dose wicked men, N will let out his vineyard 2 other husbandmen, which shall render him tha fruits in their seasons.
Jesus says 2 ’em, Did y’all never read in tha scriptures, tha stone which tha builders rejected, tha same is become tha head of tha corner: dis is tha Lord’s doin, N it is marvellous in our eyes?
Therefore say I 2 u, tha kingdom of God shall be taken from u, N given 2 a nation bringin forth tha fruits of it.
N whoever shall fall on dis stone shall be broken: but on whoever it shall fall, it will grind him 2 powder.
N when tha chief priests N Pharisees had heard his parables, dey perceived dat he spoke of ’em.
But when dey sought 2 lay hands on him, dey feared tha crowd, because dey took him 4 a prophet.

22.text: N Jesus answered N spoke 2 ’em again by parables, N said,
Tha kingdom of heaven is like 2 a certain king, which made a marriage 4 his son,
N sent forth his servants 2 call ’em dat were bidden 2 tha wedding: N dey would not come.
Again, he sent forth other servants, sayin, Tell ’em which r bidden, look, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen N my fatlings r killed, N all things r ready: come 2 tha marriage.

N he answered him 2 never a word; insomuch dat tha governor marvelled greatly.

4 he knew dat 4 envy dey had delivered him.

Then tha soldiers of tha governor took Jesus in2 tha common hall, N gathered 2 him tha whole band of soldiers.
N dey stripped him, N put on him a scarlet robe.
N when dey had platted a crown of thorns, dey put it upon his head, N a reed in his right hand: N dey bowed tha knee before him, N mocked him, sayin, Hail, King of tha Jews!
N dey spit upon him, N took tha reed, N struck him on tha head.
N after dat dey had mocked him, dey took tha robe off from him, N put his own clothing on him, N led him away 2 crucify him.
N as dey came out, dey found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him dey compelled 2 bear his cross.
N when dey were come 2 a place called Golgotha, dat is 2 say, a place of a skull,
Dey gave him vinegar 2 drink mingled wit gall: N when he had tasted of it, he would not drink.
N dey crucified him, N parted his garments, castin lots: dat it might be fulfilled which was spoken by tha prophet, dey parted my garments among ’em, N upon my vesture did dey cast lots.
N sittin down dey watched him there;
N set up over his head his accusation written, dis IS JESUS tha KING OF tha JEWS.
Then were there two thieves crucified wit him, one on tha right hand, N another on tha left.
N dey dat passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
N sayin, u dat destroy tha temple, N build it in three days, save urself. If u be tha Son of God, come down from tha cross.
Likewise also tha chief priests mockin him, wit tha scribes N elders, said,
He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be tha King of Israel, let him now come down from tha cross, N we will believe him.
He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: 4 he said, I am tha Son of God.
Tha thieves also, which were crucified wit him, cast tha same in his teeth.
Now from tha sixth hour there was darkness over all tha land 2 tha ninth hour.
N about tha ninth hour Jesus cried wit a loud voice, sayin, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? dat is 2 say, My God, my God, why have u forsaken me?
Some of ’em dat stood there, when dey heard dat, said, dis man calls 4 Elias.
N right away one of ’em ran, N took a spunge, N filled it wit vinegar, N put it on a reed, N gave him 2 drink.
Tha rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come 2 save him.
Jesus, when he had cried again wit a loud voice, yielded up tha ghost.
N, look, tha veil of tha temple was rent in twain from tha top 2 tha bottom; N tha earth did quake, N tha rocks rent;
N tha graves were opened; N many bodies of tha saints which slept arose,
N came out of tha graves after his resurrection, N went in2 tha holy city, N appeared 2 many.

N there was Mary Magdalene, N tha other Mary, sittin over against tha sepulchre.
Now tha next day, dat followed tha day of tha preparation, tha chief priests N Pharisees came together 2 Pilate,
Sayin, Sir, we remember dat dat deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

Command therefore dat tha sepulchre be made sure until tha third day, lest his disciples come by night, N steal him away, N say 2 tha people, He is risen from tha dead: so tha last error shall be worse than tha first.

28.text: In tha end of tha sabbath, as it began 2 dawn toward tha first day of tha week, came Mary Magdalene N tha other Mary 2 see tha sepulchre.
